description: A New York federal district court is considering dismissal of a lawsuit accusing several major players in the horse racing industry of engaging in racketeering and other unlawful activities related to betting by computer-assisted wagering companies.

title_en: Coup for India as G1 Winner Sosie Joins Poonawalla Stud
description: India's leading breeding operation, Poonawalla Stud, has secured four-time group 1 winner Sosie to stand as a stallion next year.

description: A set of unexpected circumstances led to veteran jockey Stewart Elliott finally reaching the 6,000 North American victories milestone on the evening of Sept. 17 at Remington Park.

description: At the end of the day, 230 horses had sold for $79,950,000, including private sales. Although this year's total dipped slightly below last year's $80,399,500, it was achieved with 22 fewer horses. The average price was up 9% to $347,609.

title_en: LaRose Aims to Score by Stocking Up at Keeneland Sale

description: Cross Gate Gallery will present the inaugural Racing Memorabilia Auction Dec. 3 at its Lexington gallery, introducing a premier new auction dedicated to the history and heritage of Thoroughbred racing.

description: A fierce bidding war in the Keeneland sales pavilion ended with John Wade's Dream Big Racing securing Hip 1018, a filly by Gun Runner, for a cool $1.5 million, the highest-priced filly of the fourth session of the Keeneland September Yearling Sale.

description: Only two years into the business of consigning horses at public auction, Norevale Farm has reached the seven-figure threshold with one of its sales.
